translator.name: stag tshang pa shes rab rin chen

item.tib: sdebs sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas ces bya ba
item.skt: ts+tshan+da rat A ka ra nA ma
item.coloph: rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sdebs sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ 'di rang 'grel dang bcas pa la chos ldan ras pa dang / yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / lo chen byang rtse ba rnams kyis sum rim du bsgyur ba'i mthar/ lo tsA ba nam mkha' bzang pos dag par bsgyur ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi dper brjod ston pa rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa/ sdebs sbyor so so'i rkang pa'i yig grangs su byas 'dug pas/ bod skad la shin tu mi bde ba gcig byung zhing / bod skad la sdebs sbyor zhig pas lci yang sogs kyi rim pa mi dgos pa bzhin du/ yig grangs kyang mi dgos/ mdo'i dper brjod ston pa rgya skad kyi dbang du byas pa yin pas/ bod la go bde zhing bzung sla bar/ stag ched pa shes rab rin chen gyis bsgyur ba'o
